 Omar Qarada opens Jordan’s medal tally with weightlifting gold at Nagoya 2026 
 last updated: 
 Oct 19,2026 
 Jordanian Paralympic champion Omar Qarada 
 + 
 - 
 Jordanian Paralympic champion Omar Qarada won the gold medal in the men’s 49kg weightlifting event on Monday morning at the 2026 Asian Para Games in Nagoya, Japan, securing Jordan’s first medal of the competition. The event took place at the Nagoya Trade and Industry Center. اضافة اعلان 
Qarada lifted 176kg to outperform all his competitors and claim his second consecutive gold medal at the Asian Para Games, and his third gold medal across his appearances at the event.
He previously won gold in Guangzhou in 2010, followed by another gold in Hangzhou in 2023. Qarada returned to the top of the podium in Nagoya in 2026, reaffirming his position among the continent’s leading competitors.
Source: Al-Ghad.
